key_insight: GDSW-type coarse spaces support scalable high-order 3D Schwarz solvers, but VEM requires moment-based representation of operator kernels to preserve coarse-level effectiveness for k≥3.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners enable scalable parallel solution of high-order finite element and virtual element systems for Poisson and linear elasticity problems.
method: Study two-level overlapping additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW, GDSW*, and RGDSW coarse spaces.
Represent operator kernels through face moments when constructing 3D VEM coarse bases.
Evaluate FEM and VEM on hexahedral meshes, plus VEM on polyhedral meshes.
evidence_signal: Tests reach polynomial degree k=5 and 4,096 subdomains and parallel cores, showing scalable Poisson iteration counts across all coarse-space variants and extension to linear elasticity.
watch_item: The VEM construction is not purely algebraic: omitting the face-moment correction makes the coarse level ineffective for k≥3.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 3D
